floor_history.headline: Recon: all 11 net-missing insns at HEAD are GTE-spelling artifacts, not C dataflow; an honest PsyQ-macro respelling builds 99/104 insns (5 gaps, score 20) and reduces the whole function to one dominan

frontier.hypothesis: H1 — reproducing target's `addu $t4,<src>,$zero` copy on each GTE operand closes 3 of the 5 missing insns AND fixes ~6 register mismatches on the canonical GTE instructions (worth ~9 of the 20 points on the honest form).
frontier.mechanism: The original C held a second variable copying the operand; GCC's local-alloc coalesced it away in every spelling tried so far. A single shared scratch is KILLED; the untried shapes are per-site local pairs (base + p) where both pseudos are referenced, and making the copy source live ACROSS the asm (the one property the mtc2 site demonstrably has).
frontier.next_probe: Start from memory/grind/func_8002EA24/candidate.c. (1) Per-site pair: `s32 *base = (s32 *)(obj + 0xF8); s32 *p = base;` and feed the asm from p. (2) Derive the store address from the load address so vp stays live: `rp = vp + 2;` (0x100-0xF8 = 8 bytes = 2 s32s — exactly target's relationship). (3) Read the .greg dump (cc1 <build-flags> -da base.i) to see which pseudo earns $t4. (4) decomp-permuter with PERM_* variants over the operand spelling if 1-3 stall.

frontier.hypothesis: H2 — the tail xori fold (2 missing insns + 1 wrong insn) is reachable by pure-C restructuring of the final 0/1 exit.
frontier.mechanism: GCC jump.c's store-flag if-conversion needs a single-set arm; it fires only on the last `return 0` because that is the one paired with a trailing `return 1`.
frontier.next_probe: Try the pure-C shapes FIRST: shared end label (`ret = 0; goto end; ... end: return ret;` per [[shared-end-label]]), mixed exit forms, and a differently-shaped final comparison. Only after those are measured dead, consider [[dead-store-fake-exception]], which documents this exact closure (dead `ret = 1;` INSIDE the else arm breaks the single-set precondition; detached placement does not work) — that path needs documented lever-exhaustion, a /* FAKE */ annotation and layer-2 review.

frontier.hypothesis: H3 — the x/$a0 vs $a1 and neg_threshold/$a1 vs $t1 assignment in the compare chain is coupled to H1 and will move on its own once the GTE region matches.
frontier.mechanism: Closing the GTE region changes which pseudos are live entering the compare chain; $t1 is an unusual first-choice allocation, consistent with neg_threshold having a longer live range than our current spelling gives it (target computes negu $t1,$a2 before the first slt and reuses it for the z test).
frontier.next_probe: Do NOT probe this before H1 lands — re-diff after H1 and only then, if it persists, apply the [[register-alloc-pure-c]] levers (block-local split, declaration order, hoisting -threshold above the x load) and read the .greg dispositions.
